papers.title: KlinikeBench: Evaluating Language Models Beyond Diagnostic Accuracy

training_data.name: KlinikeBench (Clinical-Long-Bench)
training_data.quote: Clinician agent for Clinical-Long-Bench, a Harbor benchmark of 333 long-horizon clinical consultations with a simulated patient and a clinical tool surface. Split: 283 training tasks / 50 held-out test tasks.

training_data.name: KlinikeBench trajectories (SFT initialization only)
training_data.quote: We retain only trajectories passing all four gates. This yields 1,249 trajectories covering 187 training tasks; removing sequences longer than 20,480 tokens leaves 1,235 trajectories. The paper's release note links 13,962 agent trajectories and SFT data. This GRPO checkpoint is initialized from that SFT run; it is not trained on the trajectory file directly.

source_claims.quote: The released GRPO model is step 50, the checkpoint with the best held-out pass@1. GRPO starts from the released SFT checkpoint.

languages.quote: The Hub dataset card language tag is en. The model card does not name a language.

description.text: GRPO (SkyRL) from the SFT checkpoint (`qwen3-4b-clinical-long-bench-sft`). Reward = (2·diagnosis + required_tools + parameterised_actions + must_ask) / 5. 8 tasks × 8 rollouts per step, temperature 1.0, lr 1e-6 constant, no KL, ≤ 32 agent turns / 15 min per rollout, patient simulator and must-ask judge Claude Opus 4.6. Step 50 is the RL checkpoint with the highest held-out `pass@1`.

output_type.quote: The model acts through the Harbor terminus-2 agent: every reply is a JSON object (`analysis`, `plan`, `commands`, `task_complete`) whose shell commands call the benchmark's `clinic` CLI.

use_claim.quote: Research on long-horizon clinical agents and RL reward design. Not a medical device; not for clinical use.

serving.text_only_input_quote: every reply is a JSON object (`analysis`, `plan`, `commands`, `task_complete`) whose shell commands call the benchmark's `clinic` CLI (`clinic say`, `clinic call <tool> '<json>'`).
serving.notes: config.json max_position_embeddings is 40960. tokenizer_config.json model_max_length is 131072 and has no chat_template key; the template is chat_template.jinja. The card's GRPO rollouts use temperature 1.0, which is not the value in generation_config.json. The training README evaluates held-out tasks greedily. No adapter_config.json. Hub API safetensors total is 4022468096. The SFT stage, described in the paper, fine-tunes all parameters; the GRPO section says training with FSDP and the training script has no LoRA flag, but it does not say the GRPO update itself was full. Paper Appendix C reports RL results through step 30 of a planned 315; the card and training README say the released checkpoint is step 50. Batch size 8 is the 8 tasks per step; each task has 8 rollouts.

evaluation_reported.text: Held-out, 50 test tasks, patient simulator and must-ask judge Claude Opus 4.6. This checkpoint (SFT + GRPO, multi-gate reward, step 50, 1 rollout/task): diagnosis 0.48, required tools 0.36, must-ask 0.71, pass@1 0.12. Qwen3-4B zero-shot pass@1 0.00; SFT checkpoint pass@1 0.08. The card says differences below about 0.07 are within noise and the GRPO row is a single evaluation pass.

discrepancies: The card calls the benchmark Clinical-Long-Bench. The paper, the Hub dataset anon-caa-neurips/klinikebench, and the training repo call that same 333-task benchmark KlinikeBench. This repository is the GRPO step-50 checkpoint. SFT is the separate initialization checkpoint named on the card, not a second loss run inside this repo.
